_doc: Made by blender/spacecraft/spacecraft_kit.py (docs/spacecraft.md; the pieces and every key: blender/spacecraft/KIT_NOTES.md). UE centimetres. Unless a key says otherwise everything is in the CABIN frame: origin = the middle of the cabin's floor, +X forward (the panel and the big porthole), the hatch at -X, +Z up, UE +Y = the hero's right when seated (Blender -Y). A 'frame' is {at, x, y, z, rot}: where a piece's own origin goes, its own axes as unit vectors, and the same as [pitch, yaw, roll] degrees (FRotator). 'stage.*' is in the STAGE frame: origin on the ice under the stage's axis, the hatch side at -X; the cabin frame stands at stage.cabin_seat in it, unrotated.

panel.frame_doc: origin = the face's bottom middle; u = right for the hero, v = up the face, n = out of the face; 'uv' values are cm in it
panel.needle_doc: a needle's tip at the angle a (degrees clockwise from 12 o'clock as the hero sees it) points along cos(a) * panel.v + sin(a) * panel.u; a = a_min + (value - min) / (max - min) * (a_max - a_min). SM_SC_Needle goes at needles[].frame (its +X = panel.n), scaled by needles[].scale, turned about its own X.

dials_atlas.rect_doc: [x, y, w, h] px from the top left; the face's circle is inscribed in its rect (radius atlas_circle_radius_px = the dial's radius + 3 mm); the bezel shows it out to window_radius

dials.note: an altimeter: the scale 0..9 round the whole face; the long needle turns once per 10 units, the short once per 100 (the flight code picks the unit: 100 km in space, 1 km under the parachute)

globe.doc: SM_SC_Globe: equirectangular, its own +X (lat 0, lon 0) toward the hero and +Z north at this frame; turn it so the point under the craft, own direction (cos lat cos lon, -cos lat sin lon, sin lat) in UE axes, looks along the frame's x

ball.doc: SM_SC_Ball: equirectangular (V = pitch -90..90, U round), level flight = this frame

panel.digits_doc: SC_digits: one quad per cell, UVMap 0..1 over the cell, UVData.x = (index + 0.5) / count: a count x 1 data texture (or that many scalars) tells the material each cell's digit

lamps.doc: SC_lamps: one quad per lamp. UVMap = its caption's rect on the label atlas (the material samples T_SC_Labels_<lang> with it), UVData = its cell's middle in a cols x rows data texture (row 0 at V = 0 in UE): one material instance and a 6 x 4 texture (or 24 scalars) light the lamps

bar.doc: SC_bar: UV 0..1, V = 0 (UE: 1) at the bottom

panel.toggle_doc: SM_SC_Toggle at 'off' or 'on' (blend the two); index 5 is the cabin light's switch

labels.rect_doc: [x, y, w, h] px from the top left; size_cm = the plate as printed

tonearm.doc: the angle is at the pivot between the arm and the line to the spindle; the three frames are the arm at those angles (blend between lead_in and run_out as the side plays)

ladder.facing_doc: ULyudLadderComponent's frame: its +X (toward the climber) is the stage's UE +Y

quilt.doc: tx_sc_quilt: one pillow is this square in UV; the seams are at its multiples
